what: DECL-P4-23 item 1: certification of the training zone T against X (3-D point-to-surface, the labelled-adjacency form applied in reverse), geometry only
rule: cell certified iff min over its 4 corners of (certified lower bound of the distance to X: min over the 16 nearest X vertices of |q-v| - lc_v, capped by d_16 - Lc_X) - Lc_T >= 500 vox; mask pixel (x4 downsample) true iff every strip px it covers is in a certified cell
mask_format: bool, shape ceil(T/4) x ceil(T/4) per tile, pixel (y, x) covers strip px [4y, 4y+4) x [4x, 4x+4) of the tile
